meta.system: Oracle of Tehuti — Metu Neter 70-Card Architecture

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Unseen Peace / Unconditioned Source
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Amen — I am the unshakable stillness prior to all motion.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Rooted in inner quietude, detachment from external chaos, and primal awareness; loses footing if pulled into reactive drama without centering.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Sovereign Spirit / Divine Kingship
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Ausar — My will stands indivisible with eternal law.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Natural pillar and standard-bearer who commands through principled character and long-range vision rather than emotional force.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Divine Scribe / Cosmic Intellect
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Tehuti — Exact measure and true speech establish my path.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Master strategist, decoder, and architect of systems; must balance continuous study with decisive physical execution.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Lord of the Hidden Chamber
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Seker — In sacred seclusion my enduring power is forged.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Transmutes heavy pressure and restriction into structural mastery; requires periodic quiet retreat to incubate major breakthroughs.

significators_paut_neteru.title: Cosmic Law, Truth & Reciprocity
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Maat — Truth and proportion govern every step I take.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Anchored in fairness, precision, and cosmic reciprocity; experiences immediate friction when operating inside chaotic or deceptive spaces.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Warrior of Divine Will
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Herukhuti — I sever every obstacle that opposes truth.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Built to break stagnation and defend sovereign boundaries; must ensure intensity serves Maat rather than impulsive anger.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Sovereign Solar King
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Heru — I survey the whole horizon with unclouded sight.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Harmonizes higher spirit with practical command; excels at unifying people, mission, and resources under one clear banner.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The House of Heru / Creative Magnetism
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Het-Heru — Harmonic resonance draws my rightful abundance.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Generates momentum through creative vision, beauty, and emotional resonance; weakens when confined to mechanical, joyless routine.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Lord of Precision & Tactical Mind
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Sebek — Keen discernment guides my every move.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Hyper-alert navigator of complex terrain, contracts, and environments; must temper sharp skepticism with trust in higher order.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Throne of Devotion & Astral Receptivity
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Auset — My receptive spirit captures the true signal.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Deeply intuitive, protective, and devoted; thrives when grounding inner visions into steady daily ritual.

significators_paut_neteru.title: The Sovereign Earth / Physical Manifestation
significators_paut_neteru.hekau: Nuk Pu Geb — What I conceive takes solid, lasting form on the land.
significators_paut_neteru.natal_baseline: Master builder and steward of physical assets; turns blueprint into tangible reality when guided by higher principle.

combination_rules.Success + Success: Unobstructed Alignment — Both active forces reinforce your path; execute your primary directive with full commitment.
combination_rules.Success + Failure: Tested Foundation — A strong opening is challenged by a specific behavioral friction point; correct the blind spot before scaling.
combination_rules.Failure + Success: Corrective Breakthrough — Initial resistance dissolves once you apply the specific discipline shown in the second Metut.
combination_rules.Failure + Failure: Immediate Recalibration — Halt outward expansion, return to your Natal Significator Hekau, and restore Maat before acting.
combination_rules.Timing + Success: Auspicious Window — Seasonal timing and constructive action align; step through the open door decisively.
combination_rules.Timing + Failure: Patience & Restraint — The hour requires stillness or preparation rather than force; wait out the friction cleanly.
combination_rules.Success + Timing: Structured Execution — Strong momentum governed by chronological order; pace your moves to match the cycle.
combination_rules.Failure + Timing: End of Cycle — Outdated habits are expiring with the current phase; release them so the next cycle opens clean.
combination_rules.Timing + Timing: Turning of the Wheel — A pivotal threshold moment where timing outweighs effort; observe closely and move in sync with the hour.
